Wired to helpers: dense product on 5 shelf levels, price rails, hanging numbered aisle signs, dept banners, drop-tile ceiling with troffers + sprinklers, VCT floor with specular.

Fixed the three defects: rewrote chromatic aberration in pixel units with a corner-only ramp (floor went from ~40px rainbow fringing to ~1px at the extreme corner), put the DVR stamp on one clean line inside the panel, and rebuilt the tone curve with a real highlight shoulder so the now-dense store no longer clips floor, ceiling and troffers all onto white. Also moved the wall scanlines into the panel shader so the burn-in carries them, added a keyline to the OSD font, per-monitor white points, office clutter, and fixed resize() which tore the wall apart on any canvas that was not exactly 1280x720.
